_comment: Synthetic postings for scripts/eval_normalize_posting_title.py. AUTHORED, not
scraped — the prod snapshot is PII and gitignored, so it can never be a shared
Cases are grouped. Every posting in a group is the SAME ROLE dressed in
different company/team/product noise, so they must all normalize to ONE label.
That convergence IS the feature: the label becomes `normalized_label`, the
dedup key behind the targets UNIQUE constraint, so a group that fails to
converge mints one catalog row per posting — the exact defect #745 shipped to
`expect_no_seniority` marks the #749 regression guard: the title carries NO
seniority word while the body shouts about years and staff-level scope. The
prompt's central rule is that the TITLE is the only source of seniority, so
any level word in these outputs is a real defect, not a style quibble.

groups.note: The original prod offender: a jargon title plus a trailing platform name.

postings.title: Senior Product Builder (Product Manager), Enterprise Readiness & Admin Platform
postings.jd_text: You will own the Enterprise Readiness roadmap at Wayfarer, partnering with design and engineering to ship admin tooling for our largest customers. You will define requirements, run discovery, and prioritise a backlog across two squads.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager, Helios Growth Team - R2938
postings.jd_text: Own the growth surface end to end. Partner with data science on experimentation, write specs, and drive the roadmap for activation and retention.

postings.title: Sr. Product Manager (Remote, US) — Platform
postings.jd_text: Define and deliver the platform product roadmap. Work with engineering leads on API strategy and developer experience.

groups.note: #749 GUARD. No seniority in any title; every body screams senior/staff.

postings.title: Software Engineer
postings.jd_text: Requirements: 10+ years of professional software engineering. This is a staff-level role with company-wide scope; you will set technical direction across three teams and mentor senior engineers. Compensation band reflects a principal-level hire.

postings.title: Software Engineer, Payments Core - REQ-11824
postings.jd_text: We are hiring at Northwind for our Payments Core group. You will need 12+ years of experience and will operate at a staff level, reporting to the Director of Engineering.

postings.title: Software Engineer (Berlin, Hybrid)
postings.jd_text: 8+ years required. Seniority: this role sits at the senior/staff boundary and carries architectural authority over the whole platform.

groups.note: Genuine seniority in the title, buried in req IDs, locations and employment type.

postings.title: Staff Frontend Engineer (Remote, Toronto) - Contract
postings.jd_text: Build and own the component library. Deep React and TypeScript, strong CSS, and measurable Core Web Vitals work.

postings.title: Staff Frontend Engineer — Lumen Design Systems, JR-4417
postings.jd_text: Lead the Atlas design-system rebuild. Partner with product design on tokens, accessibility and performance.

groups.note: Adjectives, emoji and punctuation the prompt is told to strip.

postings.title: Rockstar Backend Developer 🚀!!!
postings.jd_text: Join a fast-moving team building APIs in Go and Postgres. You will ship features end to end.

postings.title: Backend Developer — Ninja Superstar Wanted!
postings.jd_text: We need someone to build and operate backend services in Go, backed by Postgres, on Kubernetes.

groups.note: CONTROL for the other direction: the body legitimately disambiguates FUNCTION (not level). A prompt that ignored the body entirely would fail this.

postings.title: Data Wrangler, Beacon Foundry
postings.jd_text: You will build and maintain ELT pipelines in dbt and Airflow, model warehouse tables in Snowflake, and own data quality checks. This is a data engineering role, not analysis.
